A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have found a closed form solution for the non-planar massless double box diagram with powers of the propagators equal to 1, and one leg off shell.

the dimensionally regularized non-planar double-box master integral, with all propagators equal to unity and one leg off the shell is calculated for arbitrary values of q^4, s, t and u, in terms of (generalized) multiple polylogarithms and finite simple two- and three-fold Mellin--Bartnes integrals.

we have obtained a closed analytical result in terms of polylogarithms and simple Mellin--Bartnes integrals for the massless non-planer double box Feynmann diagram with one leg off the shell and three legs on-shell, for arbitrary values of the Mandelstamm variables and the squared momentum transferred.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the analytic calculation of the non-planar double massless box diagram, with one leg off the shell, is possible and the resulting formula is compact and simple enough to be used for numerical calculations.
, in the general case, the double box diagram is not a rational function of q^2, s, t and u, as is usually believed in the literature.

the analytic results for all the master non-planar double boxes with powers of propagator equal to one, and at most one leg off shell, have been found, and the corresponding analytic results for the master double boxes with powers two and three of propagator are expected to be obtained in the near future.
